reason: I already ask Claude or ChatGPT for a first draft, and for anything that needs a human I have a freelancer I trust. Paying 55 USDC where most entries go unpaid, judged by an AI, on an unaudited product, is more hassle than my current setup.
objection: Why not just use ChatGPT, or the one freelancer I already trust? An AI judge scoring AI-assisted entries feels circular, and I'd be locking USDC into a new, unaudited product I can't vouch for.
would_change_my_mind: A free first task that actually beats my own AI draft on a real job, plus an independent audit or a few public examples where the winning entry was clearly better than what I could get from a model.
